The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally calls `_unflatten_snapshots` for snapshot-indexed arrays attached to a network, without checking semantics or the model snapshot option. For an array with a flat, tuple-valued snapshot index and auxiliary `period`/`timestep` coordinates, this replaces the flat index with a MultiIndex before conversion to pandas, unlike the base implementation. Thus such an input can return a different result even under legacy semantics with the default or `"multiindex"` option.
